findings.one_line: The stated iff is false unless m is assumed odd: this class is a subset of M_reg and is therefore empty for even m, whereas kappa <= m(1-gamma)^(m-1) can still hold (e.g. m=2).

cited_checks.note: The supplied attestation matches the CAD use: sign-invariant cells with a sample point per cell decide the Boolean formula, including nonempty open and positive-dimensional realizations.
